name: Contextual Quarterback Index
purpose: CQI is a context-adjusted college football quarterback performance rating built around performance characteristics that historically carried forward into subsequent games.

passing_efficiency.title: Passing Efficiency
passing_efficiency.description: Network-adjusted yards per attempt. CQI evaluates pass defenses through the quarterbacks they faced rather than using a broad overall defensive rating.

sack_avoidance.title: Sack Avoidance
sack_avoidance.description: Quarterback sack tendency estimated while accounting for the opposing pass rush.

rushing.title: Rushing
rushing.description: Sustained quarterback rushing value. Opponent adjustment was tested here, but did not improve the historical forward signal.

score_scale: The public CQI score is historically anchored. A CQI of 90 represents an internal performance profile stronger than approximately 90% of qualifying historical quarterback snapshots in the 2023-2025 reference population.

validation.target: Opponent-adjusted overall quarterback performance over the following three games.
validation.holdout_note: The 2022 season was kept untouched while the v1.1 architecture, hyperparameters and weights were selected.

qualification.limited_sample: Quarterbacks with fewer than 50 attempts receive a limited-sample label.

limitations: CQI evaluates observed college quarterback performance, not pure individual talent.
Quarterback performance cannot be completely separated from offensive line play, receivers, scheme and coaching.
CQI is not an NFL scouting grade.
CQI is not a betting line, win probability or standalone wagering model.

rank_bucket_validation.interpretation: Higher CQI ratings have historically been associated with stronger subsequent opponent-adjusted quarterback performance.
rank_bucket_validation.disclaimer: Historical results are descriptive, not guarantees of future performance.
